That mechanical indentation also changed the content of the triple-quoted `_old` TTA patch sentinel. The pinned support source therefore did not match the altered sentinel; the optional TTA patch emitted a warning, and mandatory dual-seed patch 2 then found zero `_nv` blocks and failed closed.
